methodology.harness: Unchanged upstream RunStep and RunSingleBenchmark; only Date timing calls use the host monotonic clock
methodology.standaloneDependencies: Decrypt prepares one Encrypt input outside timing because its original suite ran Encrypt first
methodology.score: Complete suite only: 100 times reference microseconds divided by geometric mean of all case times; partial multi-case suites have no score
methodology.comparison: Each runtime receives the same official benchmark source and case. Scores are local observations and are not cross-device claims.
